beats.text: Five books that will quietly make you braver.
One. The Odyssey — Homer. Ten years, a thousand terrors, and one man who simply refuses to quit.
Two. Meditations — Marcus Aurelius. A ruler teaching himself to act rightly despite fear.
Three. Jane Eyre — Brontë. Quiet, unglamorous courage: refusing to betray yourself for comfort.
Four. The Call of the Wild — Jack London. Raw survival, and the nerve to meet a hard world head-on.
Five. Antigone — Sophocles. One woman defying a king, knowing exactly what it will cost her.
Courage is caught as much as taught. Borrow some from these. Full retellings on the channel.
